page.overview:
What is Gobogeg?

Gobogeg, the Twice-Invoked, also known as The Moon-Ladder in one the visions seen by Danforth (: At the Mountains of Madness) is a powerful Great Old One that appears as a colossal pillar of amorphous alien flesh, with a cyclopean head or eye in the center. (: Cthulhu Wars: Great Old One Pack Three)

When summoned in, the deity immediately causes a powerful quake that can be felt throughout the entirety of a country or even continent that it is summoned in.

To make matters worse, once it is summoned Gobogeg literally drags up the entire continent as it ascends upwards, consequently causing the entire world to cave-in on itself. (: Cthulhu Wars: Great Old One Pack Three)

It was Sandy Peterson who greatly expanded on the very vague mention of "moon-ladder" and other visions in H. P. Lovecraft's writings.
